subject: Archaeology
title: Battlefield Archaeology
description: Learn Battlefield Archaeology in one minute.

hook.text: Archaeologists now excavate WWI trenches with the same care as Roman forts.

buildup.text: At the Somme, excavators found dugouts and remains of soldiers missing a century.

discovery.text: DNA identification returns soldiers to families, closing century-old gaps.

twist.text: Live ammunition and unexploded ordnance make these sites extremely dangerous.

climax.text: Battlefield work proves recent history deserves the same rigor as the distant past.

punchline.text: A hundred years is enough for trenches to become archaeology.

quiz.question: What unique challenge does battlefield archaeology face?
options: Government secrecy laws prevent access to military sites
Live ammunition and unexploded ordnance make sites dangerous
